summary: Frontend-only verification of the two reported bugs on https://chef-tasks.preview.emergentagent.com. (1) All 3 Expo sub-apps (/taches/, /menu/, /events/) now show 3 stacked buttons on the select screen: 'Connexion' (cyan), 'Créer un restaurant' (beige), 'Créer un groupe (Holding)' (beige) - verified present, clickable, and each opens the correct form ('Créer un restaurant' with restaurant/name/email/password fields, 'Créer un Groupe' with the holding description) and 'Retour' returns to the select screen. (2) Login with groupenaga@gmail.com / LeCercle123! returns POST /api/auth/login -> 200 on all 3 apps, no 'Invalid credentials' error; taches and menu land on a fully populated dashboard. All network calls go to https://chef-tasks.preview.emergentagent.com/api/... - zero requests to localhost:8001. Landing at / still renders the 3 app cards (regression OK). Two new issues found in the Events app after login (blank dashboard + 401 race).

ui_bugs.issue: After successful login (auth/login 200) the Events dashboard body is completely empty (only header '☰ Groupe Naga ⚙️'); no content, no empty-state text, no bottom tab bar. Persists after page reload. Navigation via the ☰ menu (Menu Groupe / Événement / Facturation / Prestataires) does render, so only the default landing screen is blank - it needs a default section selection or an empty state.

data-testid props are NOT forwarded to the DOM: page.locator('[data-testid="login-button"|"register-restaurant-button"|"register-holding-button"]').count() === 0 although the strings exist in the bundle. Tests must rely on brittle French text selectors. Use RN's testID prop (which RN Web maps to data-testid) instead of a raw data-testid prop.

integration_issues.flow: events app login -> initial data load
integration_issues.issue: GET /api/prestataires/list and GET /api/events return 401 'Not authenticated' immediately after login (console errors), while the same endpoints return 200 when called with the session token via curl. Race condition: these two loaders fire before the token is stored/injected. Other calls in the same burst (categories/list, users/list, restaurants/my-restaurants, menu-restaurant/*) all return 200. After a reload the two calls are not retried at all, so the data never loads.

GET /api/permanent-subtasks/list is called 9+ times in a single dashboard load (render/effect loop). All 200 but wasteful; likely a useEffect dependency issue in DailyTasksScreen ('Loading permanent subtasks locally...' logged ~12 times).

Because all 3 web builds share one origin, a session created in /menu/ auto-logs-in /events/ and /taches/ (shared localStorage). Not the iOS behaviour described in test_credentials.md; only relevant to the web preview but can confuse testing (first /events/ probe skipped the select screen for this reason).

issues: Large empty beige area with no content or guidance after login

action_items: Fix the Events app blank default screen after login (select a default section, e.g. Menu Groupe, or render an empty state).
Fix the 401 race for /api/prestataires/list and /api/events in the Events app - await token hydration before firing these loaders and retry on 401.
De-duplicate the repeated /api/permanent-subtasks/list calls in the Taches dashboard (useEffect deps).
Switch from the raw data-testid prop to RN's testID prop on TouchableOpacity so testids reach the DOM in the web builds.
critical_code_review_comments: Events app initial-load effects call authenticated endpoints without waiting for the stored session token, producing 401s with no retry path.
React Native Web does not forward arbitrary data-* props from TouchableOpacity; use testID to keep the app automatable.

success_rate.frontend: 85% - both reported bugs fixed on all 3 apps; Events post-login dashboard broken

test_credentials: groupenaga@gmail.com / LeCercle123! - valid, login returns 200 + session_token on the preview backend
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both originally reported bugs are FIXED and verified on /taches/, /menu/, /events/: the 3 select-screen buttons exist/are clickable and login with the seeded admin works (200). Use text selectors (get_by_text('Connexion'|'Créer un restaurant'|'Créer un groupe (Holding)'|'Se connecter'|'Retour')) - data-testid is not in the DOM. Remaining open items: Events app blank post-login screen and the 401 race on /api/prestataires/list + /api/events; repeated /api/permanent-subtasks/list calls in Taches. Known/ignored: missing Ionicons TTF (tofu glyphs), full-width Connexion button on desktop. Note web sub-apps share localStorage sessions across /taches//menu//events/ - clear storage or use a fresh context before testing the select screen.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bugs: the select screen only rendered the Connexion button and the admin account was absent from the preview MongoDB. Both fixed (3 buttons in the rebuilt bundles; admin seeded via /api/auth/register-admin). New Events 401s are a client-side ordering bug, not a backend auth bug - curl with the session token returns 200 for both /api/prestataires/list and /api/events.
